title: Average resolution time by component
question: Which components have the highest average resolution time for closed incidents?

sql_tasks.description: Calculate the average resolution time for closed incidents grouped by component name, and order them in descending order to find which components have the highest average resolution time.

tasks.description: Calculate the average resolution time for closed incidents grouped by component name, and order them in descending order to find which components have the highest average resolution time.
tasks.sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS component_name,
    AVG((julianday(i.resolved_at) - julianday(i.reported_at)) * 24) AS avg_resolution_time_hours
FROM incidents i
JOIN components c ON i.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE i.status = 'closed'
GROUP BY c.component_id, c.name
ORDER BY avg_resolution_time_hours DESC
